articles.headline: Govt reduces petrol price by Rs2.20, high-speed diesel by Rs1.50
articles.summary: AI summary: The government cut petrol prices by Rs2.20 and high-speed diesel by Rs1.50 per litre effective August 8, bringing petrol to Rs327.62 and diesel to Rs380.86 per litre, continuing the daily pricing adjustments Ogra adopted after the Iran-US conflict roiled international oil markets earlier this year.

articles.headline: Goods transporters to go on strike from Saturday after talks with govt fail
articles.summary: AI summary: Pakistan's goods transporters began an indefinite nationwide wheel-jam strike after talks with the government collapsed, with the All Pakistan Goods Transport Itehad demanding uniform axle-load enforcement, higher weight limits for 10-wheelers, and cuts to diesel prices, tolls and withholding tax.

economic.reason: A nationwide, indefinite goods transport strike threatens to disrupt supply chains, freight movement and business activity until resolved.

political.reason: Breakdown of talks between a major industry body and the government signals unresolved friction and policy pressure on the administration.

social.reason: An indefinite transport strike risks shortages and price effects that touch daily life for consumers reliant on goods movement.

market.reason: Logistics and freight disruption directly affects businesses dependent on goods transport and is relevant to market observers.

lean.reason: Presents the transporters' grievances and demands on the record without editorializing for or against the government.

confidence.reason: Single-source Dawn report, but based on named, on-the-record statements from the transporters' association president.

articles.headline: Sindh govt constitutes third medical board for exhumation of Mir Ali Raza's body
articles.summary: AI summary: After withdrawing two earlier notifications, Sindh's government constituted a new eight-member medical board, led by police surgeon Dr Sumaiyya Syed, to carry out the exhumation of businessman Mir Ali Raza's body on August 8, following the family's objection to the previous board's abrupt reconstitution.
